title: Treatise on Piercing the Padded Coat
summary: Teaches how qi-packed spike thrusts defeat quilted and padded armor, for students already trained in the basic pick.

title: Handbook of the Pick and Shield Fight
summary: Sets out how the war pick beats a shield by hooking its rim, splitting its boards and reaching over the top.

title: Lessons in the Leverage Pull
summary: Shows the student how to use the curved beak and haft as a lever to drag, heave and unbalance a foe.

title: Canon of Plate-Breaking Strokes
summary: Gathers the strokes that dent, split and peel steel plate with the hammer face and the spike.

title: Workbook of the Long-Hafted Pick
summary: Drills the longer two-handed pick, with its wide guards and reaching thrusts, for students who already know the short one.

title: The Two-Handed Pick Course
summary: Walks a student from the ready stance of the two-handed pick through its chops, beats and spinning guards.

title: Notes on Unhorsing with the Pick
summary: Teaches foot soldiers to hook, prick and drag mounted riders from the saddle with a war pick.

title: A Soldier's Reading on Seam and Joint
summary: Instructs the student in finding gaps at plate joints and breaking armor hinges with the spike.
